summary: A shipped subject with an unapproved draft that a scenario is tagged for: `canon status` prints 'gate: red — 1 uncovered-cell ...; reopen with `canon subject status s --to verifying --reason "<why it reopens>"`', and that reopen is refused ('reopening needs the approved scope, and the brief is not approved — .canon/changes/b/brief.md'). The red-gate line predates 0.25 but the tagged-draft setup is the 0.25 rule; suggest the human step instead when the reopen guard would refuse.
